</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>There are three species of gemstone dragons - Dragonstone dragons, Onyx dragons, and Hydrix dragons.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ To kill them </nowiki><strong><nowiki>off-task</nowiki></strong><nowiki> in gemstone mines, you need to buy KC through these following uncut gems:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643507025602543638.png?v=1" alt="dstone" title="dstone" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Allows 2 kills each</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643411078763511828.png?v=1" alt="uncutonyx" title="uncutonyx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Allows 400 kills each</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1010485542456135730.png?v=1" alt="uncuthydrix" title="uncuthydrix" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - Allows 4000 kills each</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ If killing them in the wilderness </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150757148622921.png?v=1" alt="mandrith" title="mandrith" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or Dragonkin Laboratory </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583430542326759435.png?v=1" alt="bsd" title="bsd" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, payment is not needed.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Due to their low profitability but relatively high </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> EXP rates, they </nowiki><strong><nowiki>should be only be killed on-task</nowiki></strong><nowiki> for slayer EXP and heavily improved rare drop rates.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• All presets hence assume </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285340460449792.png?v=1" alt="slayerhelm" title="slayerhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> buffs are active on the Anachronia helmet stand.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For active methods, ranged </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is preferred with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1" alt="mechchin" title="mechchin" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1" alt="jasdragonbanearrow" title="jasdragonbanearrow" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For AFK methods </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="Magic" title="Magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is better, although </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> methods are still available.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Besides autos and standard dragonbreath attacks, each species of gemstone dragon has a special attack which fires out a set of </nowiki><strong><nowiki>gemstone spikes</nowiki></strong><nowiki>, creating a 3x3 area centred around the player after a delay, dealing high </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> damage. Additionally, gemstone spikes have the following effects:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Dragonstone Dragon: Halves the duration of antifires and super antifires.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• This </nowiki><strong><nowiki>does NOT work only</nowiki></strong><nowiki> on extended super antifires.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Onyx Dragon: Heals the dragon by up to 5000 LP.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Hydrix Dragon: Drains adrenaline to 0 and halves adrenaline gain for 15 seconds.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="desirable-drops"><nowiki>Desirable Drops</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Besides the Draconic Visage (1/10000) which most dragons drop, different dragons drop the different pieces of Gemstone Armour (T80 hybrid, unaugmentable) required for the Karamja slayer log:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dragonstone Dragon: Gemstone Gloves and Boots</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Onyx Dragon: Gemstone Helmet and Greaves</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Hydrix Dragon: Gemstone Hauberk</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ All Gemstone dragons have a static droprate for Armour pieces at a rate of 1/2500 off-task and 1/1000 on-task.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• For Dragonstone and Onyx Dragons this is then 50% chance to be either of the pieces they can drop.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="location-and-how-to-get-there"><nowiki>Location and How to Get There</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Gemstone dragons are located below the Shilo Village Mines. A ladder leads to the cavern beside Kelhar, which requires Karamja Gloves 3 or above to access.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• The teleport option on Karamja Gloves 3 or higher is the fastest way to access the cavern.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ They are also found in the Wilderness Dungeon just south of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150757148622921.png?v=1" alt="mandrith" title="mandrith" kind="icon" /><nowiki>. The quickest way to get there is by teleporting to </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150757148622921.png?v=1" alt="mandrith" title="mandrith" kind="icon" /><nowiki> using the Slayer Cape </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/975284344123953164.png?v=1" alt="slayercape" title="slayercape" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, walk south and down the ladder.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Item unlocks</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Scrimshaw_of_sacrifice <strong><nowiki>Scrimshaw of Sacrifice</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150750915899402.png?v=1" alt="sacrificescrim" title="sacrificescrim" kind="icon" /><nowiki>
    • Can be used for 50% increased </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> exp
    • Feasible as dragons have high base </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> exp and are not killed for profit.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_slayer_gloves <strong><nowiki>Dragon slayer gloves</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1080862450167054356.png?v=1" alt="dragonslayergloves" title="dragonslayergloves" kind="icon" /><nowiki>

    • If AFKing and not using the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150750915899402.png?v=1" alt="sacrificescrim" title="sacrificescrim" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, players can use this to upkeep prayer points.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Passive unlocks</nowiki></u><nowiki>

    • Allows </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> restocking without user input.
⬥ </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Death_Ward <strong><nowiki>Death ward</nowiki></strong>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774068699286.png?v=1" alt="deathward" title="deathward" kind="icon" /><nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="dragonstone-dragons"><ins><nowiki>Dragonstone dragons</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Dragonstone dragons are the easiest of the 3 and should only be done for the slayer log or if under levelled. If under geared or not confident, using extended super antifires is recommended to take less damage from dragonbreath, especially if AFKing.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 95</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896050370281523.png?v=1" alt="combat" title="combat" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 2781.4 + 917.8 HP</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 1448.4</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour - ~278 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, ~400 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP hour - 402k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> , 580k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP hour with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1023150750915899402.png?v=1" alt="sacrificescrim" title="sacrificescrim" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - 603k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, 870k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="method-and-where-to-stand"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Method and Where to stand</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Place cannon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on yellow tile as shown below and stand under the cannon.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1" alt="sorrow" title="sorrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1" alt="ruination" title="ruination" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/8PsXDPyfI2.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="method-and-where-to-stand_1"><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> Method and Where to stand</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ It is ideal to kill them one at a time, using an </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to cycle through 2 spawns in the south eastern corner of the cavern.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and t95/t99 curse for the respective style.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Place cannon </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/869283142350041098.png?v=1" alt="cannon" title="cannon" kind="icon" /><nowiki> on yellow tile as shown below, and stand on the red tile so you avoid the special attacks.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/8XkgcYN497.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /><nowiki>
​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section" data-gear="true">
<h2 id="presets-and-relics"><ins><nowiki>Presets and Relics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=JENrK716aS3O2cnOgjwt <nowiki>Magic - AFK</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/c70259c4f99136af33d445b75fa18798d5ff257bfab74dacf8d44ff725878899.webp" alt="Unnamed preset" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=xNa3WY3MubHwZaeGKZVT <nowiki>Ranged - AFK</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><pvme-image src="https://pvme.io/preset-maker-storage/embeds/images/60d4e92c1a90d75e1cd52ffe8af3a3eb5b0123436ee2c543aae10512d690cd81.webp" alt="Unnamed preset" kind="addition" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki>[https://presets.pvme.io/?id=6OLKe4r0Er7VteVwWvrV <nowiki>Necromancy - AFK</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/583429936958930964.png?v=1" alt="torment" title="torment" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190158468907008.png?v=1" alt="affliction" title="affliction" kind="icon" /></p>

</nowiki>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689525476158472288.png?v=1" alt="weppoison" title="weppoison" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times</nowiki></p>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="hydrix-dragons"><ins><nowiki>Hydrix dragons</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Hydrix dragons is relevant to players desiring slayer log completion and high exp rates. They provide more than twice the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> exp per kill of Onyx dragons and is considered one of the highest exp/hr tasks in the game if done actively.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="method-active-ranged"><ins><nowiki>Method: Active Ranged</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Use to the low accuracy of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and the existence of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/971025697042755584.png?v=1" alt="jasdragonbanearrow" title="jasdragonbanearrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> is the best style for slaying hydrix dragons actively.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Place the </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and position as shown in the picture below. Place your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /><nowiki> around the area the player is positioned in the picture.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The main dragons you'll be chinning are the ones in the top right (yellow box) which your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/798285651387613194.png?v=1" alt="oldakcoil" title="oldakcoil" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will aggro and align for you. The dragons shown in the blue and red boxes can be opportunistically chinned if you manage to lure them correctly.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/626466665848242186.png?v=1" alt="sgb" title="sgb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1257438999794946099.png?v=1" alt="eofspec" title="eofspec" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535534127131394088.png?v=1" alt="snap" title="snap" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/535541270521708566.png?v=1" alt="rapid" title="rapid" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/642713547142332416.png?v=1" alt="shadowtend" title="shadowtend" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1" alt="mechchin" title="mechchin" kind="icon" /><nowiki> prioritised in that order to quickly AoE pairs down.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Chin Deadshot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/641669268722810881.png?v=1" alt="mechchin" title="mechchin" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/959089455283728386.png?v=1" alt="deadshotigneous" title="deadshotigneous" kind="icon" /><nowiki> can be used when out of </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/994644354536837121.png?v=1" alt="gdeathsswift" title="gdeathsswift" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/662249620579155968.png?v=1" alt="dommine" title="dommine" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513201065513058306.png?v=1" alt="Tuskas" title="Tuskas" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to quickly kill dragons single target.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/UE1pYge.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pay close attention to the dragons' specs especially if you have more than 2 attacking you.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
